keyVerseDR: "I am the resurrection and the life: he that believeth in me, although he be dead, shall live." (Jn 11:25)

level1.title: Lazarus, Come Out!
level1.story: Jesus' friend Lazarus died. Martha and Mary were very sad, and Jesus cried too. Jesus said, "Lazarus, come out!" and he lived again!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you be a good friend?
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are my life. Amen.

activity.title: How did they feel?
activity.intro: Draw each face: sad before, happy after!

level2.title: The Resurrection and the Life
level2.story: Lazarus, the brother of Martha and Mary, was very sick, and he died. When Jesus came to Bethany, Martha said, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died." Jesus said, "I am the resurrection and the life." Seeing Mary and the others weeping, Jesus wept too. At the tomb He cried out, "Lazarus, come out!" and Lazarus walked out alive.
level2.keyLine: I am the resurrection and the life.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus cry even though He knew He would raise Lazarus?
What does 'I am the resurrection' mean for us?
actions: Make the Stations of the Cross
level2.prayer: Jesus, give me hope and new life. Amen.

activity.title: Memory verse
activity.intro: Read it, fold one line at a time, and say it from memory.
activity.question: What did Jesus tell Martha?
activity.answer: I am the resurrection and the life: he that believeth in Me, although he be dead, shall live.
